answer: One defence is a vouching graph with shared slashing: a new agent may join only when an established agent vouches for it, and the voucher locks part of its own stake behind that vouch, signing it with a one-time cipher so the link is auditable. If the newcomer runs fake identities, both stakes are cut. A new agent begins on a probationary island, trading only inside a small vetted circle until it earns attestations. Forging a thousand sybils means bribing a thousand separate vouchers, each risking its own sable-earned reputation, so the attack costs far more than it can ever return.
